description: How the browser follows one space artifact creation on the hub. While the hub answers (any 2xx status), the creation is never concluded by the browser: it polls with a backoff from pollInitialMs doubling to pollMaxMs and reports every hub phase, and the person may cancel. Only when the hub has not answered for unreachableBoundMs does the browser conclude `indeterminate` (the outcome is then truly unknown and the space must be refreshed).
